name: MemOS
summary: Open-source memory operating system for LLMs and agents with a unified API for adding, retrieving, editing and deleting graph-structured, multi-modal memory.
description: Offered self-hosted and as MemOS Cloud, with local and cloud memory plugins for agents such as OpenClaw and Hermes Agent. The Python package is published on PyPI as `MemoryOS` (2.0.33 as of Sep 2026; GitHub is at v2.0.34), which is unrelated to BAI-LAB's MemoryOS.
